sections.text:
Item # 1: Biologists have discovered a method to induce photoswitching in a species of worm, so that it becomes paralyzed when exposed to ultraviolet light, and then unparalyzed when exposed again to visible light.
Item #2: Programmers have developed PC software that uses the optical mouse sensor to detect bacterial food contamination.
Item # 3: Astronomers have discovered two extra-solar earth-sized objects with oxygen rich atmospheres.
